properties.summary: Illustrative massing: one simple volume for the approved 72-story tower, the site inset evenly to the building's average floor area (about 12,250 sq ft) and extruded to the 795-ft roof. The approved plans weren't available, so the tower's real outline, its garage podium, the rooftop features to 844 ft and the bridge to Salesforce Park are not drawn.
properties.note: A placeholder volume of the approved size, not the design.

properties.source: illustrative: the site (DataSF parcels 3721/013 and 014) inset evenly to the average gross floor area per story in the SF Planning record 2023-010883TDM (524 and 530 Howard Street), DataSF Planning records (about 882,251 sq ft over 72 stories); roof height from the same record
properties.note: About 795 ft to the roof, 844 ft with mechanical penthouse levels and screening. The real floor plate, setbacks and garage podium aren't known from the documents read.
